<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Initiate Warden](/Feats.aspx?ID=4862) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 157

</column>

---

You’ve trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the initial [warden spells](https://2e.aonprd.com/Spells.aspx?Trait=136) (or another you have access to).

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different initial warden spell each time.

<title level="2">Initiate Warden leads to...</title>
[Advanced Warden](/Feats.aspx?ID=4870), [Masterful Warden](/Feats.aspx?ID=4878), [Peerless Warden](/Feats.aspx?ID=4890)
name: Initiate Warden
